name: AI Hero purchase denial at owner turn after long era wait

condition.code: return Game.GetLocalPlayer()>=0 and Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]:IsTurnActive() and ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption~=nil and ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroLifespanKey~=nil and ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI~=nil

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay);local e=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_EXPECT_V1')
local m=assert(A.GetHeroesManager());local class=GameInfo.HeroClasses['HEROCLASS_JAC_WARLORD_A'].Index
local record=assert(A.GetRoster(e.To)['live:hero']);local u=assert(A.FindUnit(e.To,record.Unit.Token))
assert(u:IsHero() and u:GetHeroClassType()==class,'recall death fixture is not a native hero')
local origin=m:GetHeroOriginCityID(class);local city=assert(Players[e.To]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_RECALL_V1',{Owner=e.To,EraBefore=Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra(),Class=class,CityID=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Record=A.Canonical(record)})
UnitManager.Kill(u)
Players[e.To]:GetReligion():ChangeFaithBalance(1000000)
assert(m:GetHeroClaimPlayer(class)==e.To,'native death lost absorber recall rights')
assert(A.Canonical(A.GetRoster(e.To)['live:hero'])==Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_RECALL_V1').Record,'death lost contract/loyalty/relations')
return 'native Warlord A retired for engine recall eligibility probe; faith funded'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay);local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_RECALL_V1'))
local origin=assert(A.GetHeroesManager():GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class))
local city=assert(Players[e.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
local class=assert(GameInfo.Units[GameInfo.HeroClasses[e.Class].UnitType].FormationClass)
local blockers={}
for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
 if u:GetX()==city:GetX() and u:GetY()==city:GetY() and GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].FormationClass==class then blockers[#blockers+1]=u end
end
table.sort(blockers,function(a,b) return a:GetID()<b:GetID() end)
for _,u in ipairs(blockers) do
 local placed=false;local damage=u:GetDamage();local moves=u:GetMovesRemaining()
 for x=city:GetX()-6,city:GetX()+6 do
  for y=city:GetY()-6,city:GetY()+6 do
   local plot=Map.GetPlot(x,y)
   if not placed and plot and plot:GetOwner()==e.Owner and not plot:IsWater() and not plot:IsImpassable() and (x~=city:GetX() or y~=city:GetY()) then
    local units=Map.GetUnitsAt(plot)
    if not units or units:GetCount()==0 then
     UnitManager.PlaceUnit(u,x,y)
     if u:GetX()==x and u:GetY()==y then u:SetDamage(damage);u:ChangeMovesRemaining(moves-u:GetMovesRemaining());placed=true end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 assert(placed,'no empty owned plot for recall spawn blocker '..u:GetID())
end
return 'recall spawn blockers relocated without deletion: '..#blockers

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_RECALL_V1'))
assert(Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()>e.EraBefore,'global era boundary not processed')
local alive={}
for _,unit in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
 if unit.IsHero and unit:IsHero() and unit:GetHeroClassType()==e.Class then
  local person=unit:GetProperty(A.Rules.PERSON_KEY)
  assert(not person or person.ID=='live:hero','same Hero class belongs to another person')
  alive[#alive+1]=unit
 end
end
assert(#alive<=1,'ambiguous AI Hero instances after era wait')
for _,unit in ipairs(alive) do UnitManager.Kill(unit) end
for _,unit in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
 assert(not unit.IsHero or not unit:IsHero() or unit:GetHeroClassType()~=e.Class,
  'controlled Hero remains alive before official recall')
end
print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_POST_ERA_HERO_RETIRED] count='..#alive)
A.BeginHeroRecall('japan-ai-recall:1','japan-live-absorption','live:hero')
return 'actual AI recall intent saved before the owner turn'

local api=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption)
local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_RECALL_V1'))
local manager=Game.GetHeroesManager()
local def=GameInfo.HeroClasses[e.Class]
local native=GameInfo.Units[def.UnitType]
local params={[CityCommandTypes.PARAM_UNIT_TYPE]=native.Hash,
 [CityCommandTypes.PARAM_MILITARY_FORMATION_TYPE]=MilitaryFormationTypes.STANDARD_MILITARY_FORMATION,
 [CityCommandTypes.PARAM_YIELD_TYPE]=GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index}
JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE={Owner=e.Owner,Class=e.Class,OriginBefore=manager:GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class),Existing={},Trace={},FaithChanges={},Purchases={},Spawns={}}
for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE.Existing[u:GetID()]=true end
if JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_HANDLER then Events.GameCoreEventPublishComplete.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_HANDLER) end
if JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_FAITH_HANDLER then Events.FaithChanged.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_FAITH_HANDLER) end
if JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_COMMAND_HANDLER then Events.CityCommandStarted.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_COMMAND_HANDLER) end
if JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_UNIT_HANDLER then Events.UnitAddedToMap.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_UNIT_HANDLER) end
local function trace(kind,entry)
 local p=JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE
 if not p.Requested or p.Complete or p.Error then return end
 entry.Kind=kind;entry.Order=#p.Trace+1;p.Trace[#p.Trace+1]=entry
end
JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_FAITH_HANDLER=function(owner,yield,balance)
 local p=JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE
 if owner~=e.Owner or not p.Requested or p.Complete or p.Error then return end
 trace('FAITH',{Owner=owner,Yield=yield,Balance=balance})
 if balance~=p.LastFaith then p.FaithChanges[#p.FaithChanges+1]={Before=p.LastFaith,After=balance};p.LastFaith=balance end
end
JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_COMMAND_HANDLER=function(owner,city,districtOwner,district,command,data)
 local p=JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE
 if owner~=e.Owner or not p.Requested or p.Complete or p.Error then return end
 trace('COMMAND',{Owner=owner,City=city,Command=command,Data=data})
 if command==CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE then p.Purchases[#p.Purchases+1]={City=city,Command=command,Data=data} end
end
JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_UNIT_HANDLER=function(owner,id,x,y)
 local p=JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE
 if owner~=e.Owner or not p.Requested or p.Complete or p.Error then return end
 local class=-1;for _,u in Players[owner]:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetID()==id then class=u:GetHeroClassType() end end
 trace('UNIT',{Owner=owner,ID=id,Class=class,X=x,Y=y})
 p.Spawns[#p.Spawns+1]={ID=id,Class=class,X=x,Y=y}
end
Events.FaithChanged.Add(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_FAITH_HANDLER)
Events.CityCommandStarted.Add(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_COMMAND_HANDLER)
Events.UnitAddedToMap.Add(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_UNIT_HANDLER)
JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_HANDLER=function()
 local p=JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE
 if p.Complete or p.Error then return end
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  if not p.Requested then
   if not Players[e.Owner]:IsTurnActive() then return end
   assert(not Players[e.Owner]:IsHuman() and not Players[1]:IsTurnActive(),'AI recall changed controller/turn')
   assert(Game.GetLocalPlayer()<0 or Game.GetLocalPlayer()==e.Owner,'another human command context')
   assert(Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()>e.EraBefore,'global era boundary not processed')
   local origin=manager:GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class)
   assert(manager:GetHeroClaimPlayer(e.Class)==e.Owner and origin.player==e.Owner and origin.id==e.CityID,'AI recall claim/origin changed')
   local city=assert(Players[e.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
   p.OriginX=city:GetX();p.OriginY=city:GetY()
   local allowed,results=CityManager.CanStartCommand(city,CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE,false,params,true)
   p.Query={OwnerActive=true,LocalPlayer=Game.GetLocalPlayer(),IsHuman=Players[e.Owner]:IsHuman(),Turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(),Era=Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra(),Allowed=allowed,Results=results}
   local failures={}
   local reasonKey=CityCommandResults and CityCommandResults.FAILURE_REASONS
   if reasonKey and results and results[reasonKey] then
    for _,reason in ipairs(results[reasonKey]) do failures[#failures+1]=tostring(reason) end
   end
   assert(allowed,'native recall not allowed on actual owner turn; reasons='
    ..table.concat(failures,',')..' query='..api.Canonical(p.Query))
   p.CostBefore=city:GetGold():GetPurchaseCost(GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index,native.Hash,MilitaryFormationTypes.STANDARD_MILITARY_FORMATION)
   p.FaithBefore=Players[e.Owner]:GetReligion():GetFaithBalance()
   p.LastFaith=p.FaithBefore
   assert(p.CostBefore>0 and p.FaithBefore>=p.CostBefore,'native AI recall cost/faith invalid')
   p.Requested=true
   trace('REQUEST',{Owner=e.Owner,City=origin.id,Class=e.Class,Cost=p.CostBefore,Faith=p.FaithBefore})
   CityManager.RequestCommand(city,CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE,params)
   print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_REQUEST] '..api.Canonical(p))
   return
  end
  for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
   if u:GetHeroClassType()==e.Class and not p.Existing[u:GetID()] then
    assert(not p.NewID,'multiple native recall candidates')
    p.NewID=u:GetID()
   end
  end
  if p.NewID then
   local origin=manager:GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class)
   local city=assert(Players[e.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
   p.FaithAfter=Players[e.Owner]:GetReligion():GetFaithBalance()
   p.CostAfter=city:GetGold():GetPurchaseCost(GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index,native.Hash,MilitaryFormationTypes.STANDARD_MILITARY_FORMATION)
   p.ClaimAfter=manager:GetHeroClaimPlayer(e.Class);p.OriginAfter=origin
   p.Complete=true
   print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_COMPLETE] '..api.Canonical(p))
  end
 end)
 if not ok then p.Error=tostring(err);print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_ERROR] '..p.Error) end
end
Events.GameCoreEventPublishComplete.Add(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_HANDLER)
local function detached(value)
 if type(value)~='table' then return value end
 local result={}
 for key,entry in pairs(value) do result[detached(key)]=detached(entry) end
 return result
end
ExposedMembers.JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_READ=function() return detached(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE) end
return 'real purchase handler prepared; strict query only on the existing AI owner active turn'

local p=assert(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE)
assert(not p.Error,p.Error);assert(p.Requested and p.Complete,'AI purchase did not complete')
assert(p.Query.OwnerActive and not p.Query.IsHuman and p.Query.Allowed,'AI purchase used invalid query context')
assert(p.FaithBefore-p.FaithAfter==p.CostBefore,'native AI recall payment changed')
assert(#p.Trace==3 and p.Trace[1].Kind=='REQUEST' and p.Trace[2].Kind=='FAITH' and p.Trace[3].Kind=='UNIT','AI recall payment interval includes unrelated or unordered events')
assert(#p.FaithChanges==1 and p.FaithChanges[1].Before==p.FaithBefore and p.FaithChanges[1].After==p.FaithAfter,'AI recall payment mixed other faith changes')
assert(#p.Spawns==1 and p.Spawns[1].ID==p.NewID and p.Spawns[1].Class==p.Class
 and p.Spawns[1].X==p.OriginX and p.Spawns[1].Y==p.OriginY,'AI recall receipt is not the target Hero at its origin')
assert(p.CostAfter>p.CostBefore,'native recall cost did not increase')
assert(p.ClaimAfter==p.Owner and p.OriginAfter.player==p.Owner and p.OriginAfter.id==p.OriginBefore.id,'AI recall claim/origin changed')
Events.GameCoreEventPublishComplete.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_HANDLER)
Events.FaithChanged.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_FAITH_HANDLER)
Events.CityCommandStarted.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_COMMAND_HANDLER)
Events.UnitAddedToMap.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_UNIT_HANDLER)
return ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption.Canonical(p)
